name: singlet_annotation_mislabelled_cell_detection
title: Mislabelled and ambiguous cell detection
description: Audits an existing cell-type label against expression: scores each cell, flags erroneous and ambiguous cells, and proposes a supported alternative label. The default method annotatability trains a small network on the given labels and needs no reference; confident_learning and screclassify are alternatives. Writes obs/mislabel_* and uns/mislabel_purity_per_type. Do not use it to label unannotated cells; use reference label transfer for that.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

label_key.description: obs column holding the existing label to audit; required.

method.description: Audit method; annotatability is the default and needs no reference.

embedding_key.description: obsm key used by confident_learning and screclassify; annotatability uses X.

flag_fraction.description: Lowest-scoring fraction reported as erroneous for annotatability and screclassify; confident_learning uses its pruning rule.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for training, resampling and fold assignment.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

annotatability.description: Options for method annotatability; ignored by other methods.

epochs.description: Training epochs; confidence and variability depend on this value.

ambiguity_band.description: Half-width of the ambiguity band in units of var(confidence); 1.0 reproduces the source rule.

confident_learning.description: Options for method confident_learning; ignored by other methods.

screclassify.description: Options for method screclassify; ignored by other methods.

base_classifier.description: Base classifier of the adaSampling ensemble.

percent.description: Draws per class as a fraction of its size, with replacement.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_cells, n_correct, n_erroneous and n_ambiguous; the per-type table is uns/mislabel_purity_per_type.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
